items.exampleEn: We had dinner first and went for a walk afterward.
items.exampleZh: 我們先吃晚餐，之後去散步。

items.exampleEn: Whoever arrives first should open the windows.
All the passengers are now aboard.
items.exampleZh: 所有乘客現在都已經上機（上船）了。

items.exampleEn: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
items.exampleZh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

items.exampleEn: I am not sure whether he will come tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 我不確定他明天會不會來。

items.exampleEn: Ten people came to the meeting, including the manager.
items.exampleZh: 有十個人來開會，包括經理在內。

items.exampleEn: The tickets cost twenty dollars per person.
Despite the bad weather, the flight left on time.
items.exampleZh: 儘管天氣不好，班機還是準時起飛。

items.exampleEn: The road was closed, and thus we were late.
items.exampleZh: 那條路封閉了，因此我們遲到了。

items.sentenceEn: Whoever finishes the work first can go home early.
items.sentenceZh: 誰先完成工作，誰就可以早點回家。

items.audioEn: Despite the long delay, Lisa stayed calm and waited for the next train.
items.audioZh: 儘管延誤了很久，Lisa 仍然保持冷靜，等下一班火車。
items.questionZh: Lisa 遇到延誤時怎麼做？
options: She waited for the next train.

items.sentenceEn: We will decide whether to travel after we check the weather.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看過天氣之後，再決定要不要去旅行。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel costs one hundred dollars per night, including breakfast.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店每晚一百美元，含早餐。

items.stemEn: ____ the heavy rain, the game continued.
items.stemZh: 儘管雨下得很大，比賽仍然繼續進行。

items.stemEn: We missed the last bus and ____ had to walk home.
items.stemZh: 我們錯過了末班公車，因此只好走路回家。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, Kevin and his family took a boat trip around the island. Everyone, including his grandmother, was aboard by eight o'clock. Despite the strong wind, the trip was calm. Kevin did not know whether there would be any food on the boat, so he brought sandwiches. Afterward, his family thanked him. The trip cost thirty dollars per person, and Kevin said it was worth it.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，Kevin 和家人搭船環島旅遊。八點前，所有人都上船了，包括他的奶奶。儘管風很大，航程還算平穩。Kevin 不知道船上會不會有吃的，所以帶了三明治。後來，家人都向他道謝。這趟行程每人三十美元，Kevin 說很值得。

options: 因為不確定船上有沒有吃的

items.promptZh: 儘管很累，她還是完成了工作。
referenceEn: Despite being tired, she finished the work.
Despite feeling tired, she finished her work.
rubricZh: despite 後面接名詞或動名詞，不接完整句子
主要句用過去式（例如 finished、completed）

items.instructionZh: 用 whether 造一個句子，說說一件你還沒決定的事。
referenceEn: I have not decided whether to take the job.
I am not sure whether I should call him.
rubricZh: 可以用 whether to＋原形動詞

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：評分要點寫死單一動詞 finished（準則 §1）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "主要句用過去式（例如 finished、completed）"（原 "主要句用過去式 finished"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：參考答案 2 主詞是 she，不是「你」（準則 §2）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "I am not sure whether I should call him."（原 "She is not sure whether she should call him."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：aboard 介系詞用法（aboard the plane）為 C1，改示範 B1 副詞用法
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "All the passengers are now aboard."（原 "All the passengers are now aboard the plane."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "所有乘客現在都已經上機（上船）了。"（原 "所有乘客現在都已經登機了。"）
